house.description: Commissioner of education directed to amend the state's accountability plan.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Education Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; directing the commissioner of education to amend the state's accountability plan.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+NORTH STAR PLAN CALCULATIONS. +]

[+The commissioner of education must amend the state's accountability plan, North Star, adopted under the federal Every Student Succeeds Act. The commissioner must not require a school district to report a score on the Minnesota Comprehensive Assessments for a student who opts out of the assessment. A student who opts out of the assessment must not be included in any of the student group data used to calculate a district's or school's achievement rates. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective for the 2025-2026 school year and later. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; directing the commissioner of education to amend the state's accountability plan.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. NORTH STAR PLAN CALCULATIONS.

The commissioner of education must amend the state's accountability plan, North Star, adopted under the federal Every Student Succeeds Act. The commissioner must not require a school district to report a score on the Minnesota Comprehensive Assessments for a student who opts out of the assessment. A student who opts out of the assessment must not be included in any of the student group data used to calculate a district's or school's achievement rates.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for the 2025-2026 school year and later.

This section is effective for the 2025-2026 school year and later.
